deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified interface definitions
Agent-first documentation, protocol skills packaging operations, and an MCP server for agent discovery and calls
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, with 3 per quarter
Shared infrastructure for all protocols on the Tx3 registry
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Tx3 by TxPipe, described as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and AI-agent interfaces.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 1,684,050 ADA.
Tx3 is intended to provide a single open, standardized interface so developers and AI agents can discover, integrate, and compose Cardano on-chain protocols.
The proposer says Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and raising integration costs.
Tx3 is described as producing documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from one verified interface definition for each protocol.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to onboarding 12 additional protocols, 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe is said to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule.

The proposal states that funds will be administered through Intersect treasury smart contracts with milestone-based disbursement controls, external oversight entities, and public dashboard/on-chain auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe project to expand Tx3 as an open API and AI-agent interface layer for Cardano protocols, with Intersect smart-contract administration and referenced governance, audit, and dashboard materials.
